text: {"lessons":["Repeatedly selling Stock A, B and E after gains may reduce risk, but gains versus my cost alone are not a reason to sell; I should consider each holding's role in my portfolio.","Mostly holding steady kept trading infrequent, but I should still review diversification and exposure so a few stocks cannot put my retirement savings at undue risk.","My account rose for several periods and then declined; short-term gains do not ensure stability, so I should prioritize preserving funds for living expenses over chasing returns."]}
